Type is computed using original action battler before the actual user can be replaced by Snatch; the user replacement updates the ability-ignore context and preselection. Later move-owned callbacks receive the actual user. These phases must not be treated as a uniform caster snapshot.

A true no-target branch and a per-hit all-target failure are different. The first marks failure; the latter also invokes crash/item/cancel behavior through its own path. If a two-turn marker was already written before the former branch, that branch has no explicit cancel call.
